evaluation_policy.automated_scope: Node.js validates pinned source versions, allowed file hashes, required evidence, run provenance, objective IDs and calibrated AI levels; OpenCode returns candidate judgments only. The finalizer ignores any AI-supplied completion or pass flag.

formal_assessment.candidate_evaluator: OpenCode CLI in a separate read-only session
formal_assessment.finalizer: Node.js deterministic validation and phase aggregation

calibration.scope: exact model id + OpenCode version + evaluator prompt SHA-256 + pinned scoring/rubric asset hashes
calibration.retain_expected_decision_labels_as: public calibration-fixture labels only; never convert them directly to learner Level 0-3
